summary: Excellent TypeScript practices: pure functions, explicit types, no `any`, deterministic date math. Workflow follows best practices: pinned actions, least-privilege permissions, sensible triggers. Minor issues: bun setup duplicated in workflow (lines 26–34 and 43–51, ~8 lines); hardcoded directory list in stageCase (line 142) risks maintenance if project structure changes. Act output parsing via regex could fail on edge cases (e.g., secret names containing delimiters). Overall: production-ready, ship with confidence.
